description: One defender's record: a verdict on each finding of the round. A defender refutes a finding only by quoting the code that shows it is wrong; a refutation without a quote does not count.

defender.description: This defender's name, the same in every entry (for example defender-1).

defenses.description: One entry per finding of the round.

quote.description: The line of code the defender relies on.

diff_sha256.description: The sha256 of the change this record was made against: the value in your brief, as `plumbline.py check-diff --run RUN` prints it. `merge-review` refuses a record whose hash differs from the change as the files are now, so a change edited after you read it means you run again.
